subject: Focused real-terminal Help reachability on official dd1a6baa TUI
conclusion: Four requested TTY sizes in dark/light reach the final command-summary quit and complete Clipboard explanation through real j keys; actual Esc returns to Chats. Confirmed in fresh125 and fresh200 scopes. First5-j scope is a driver limitation, not a product failure.
success_basis: Actual original full-resolution PNG visual review
Actual TTY ioctl size and X11 window geometry
Live /proc/PID/exe SHA matching frozen official binary
Final command summary quit + full Clipboard explanation + status/Esc footer + real Esc return, NOT driver exit or repeated pixels alone
limits: Single WezTerm 20221119-145034-49b9839f / tmux3.6a chain, unicode_version9, tmux variation-selector-always-wide off, DejaVu/LilyHan/Noto fallback. Not all-terminalMatrix completion.
Sizes only60x24,70x24,70x40,80x40; monochrome terminal default dark/light, not all themes or palette contrast certification.
Help opened from real Chats after real SDK fixture seed/login. No app state injection, no fake product controls, no synthetic screenshot content.
Esc back was exercised, not k/Home reverse-scroll or interactive execution of every documented command.
CLI safe exit used real Ctrl+C, not :quit business command execution.
Only Help reachability focused here; no EGC clipboard/atomicity, Unicode18, all business pages or genuine empty-state assertion.
125 and200 are actual recorded key counts, not a product-required count. First five unchanged frames were insufficient to locate bottom because selection can move within viewport.
Old300-image visual report remains immutable; this is a supplemental runtime audit, not a relabel of whole300 matrix PASS.
